text: **Combined Search (category, keyword, parameter)** If Customer has already selected a category relevant to what they are looking for but they do not see a sub-category that also matches their needs (or there are multiple apparently relevant sub-categories and they choose not to explore each one), they may choose to search within a category. This can be a simple search but is generally an advanced search where Customer selects from a set of parameters (features) that are relevant for the category they are searching in.
